acceptanceCriteria: An owner decision records whether packet actions for a bug report stay conditional when the named symbol already has a guarding test, and whether a held-out set of real already-fixed tasks is required before any promotion claim.
body: Filed on 2026-09-23 from the independent reviews of the V1 wave-3 pull requests. Review of PR #96 (V1-0097): the already-fixed control fails every corvint packet with rows because Corvint has no already-fixed signal (a stated non-goal). The offline pilot on the synthetic 3-file fixture got READY with port.go, port_test.go and README.md, verdict no-specific-terms, packet_abstained 0. The rows are the evidence that the fix exists, not invented certainty, so this is not a confirmed invariant-2 gap. Evidence: BUILD-LOG V1-0097; tools/cw-trial/control.go:44-73. After the PR #96 review fixes, `control_failed` counts only a `certain` claim on every arm and `packet_abstained` is a separate diagnostic (CEP-V0-005, decision 0372), so that part of the question is settled; the two remaining questions stand.
title: context: already-fixed control (CEP-V0-004/005) fails every corvint packet with rows; decide how Corvint should answer an already-fixed task
